glosses: wire (metal formed into a long, narrow thread)
alambre (Mexican food dish consisting of meat topped with cheese, salsa, and chopped bacon, pepper and onion)

examples.text: Esta jaula está hecha de alambre.
examples.en: This cage is made of wire.
We'll have to separate the wires.

examples.text: Los niños hicieron esculturas de alambre.
examples.en: The children made sculptures out of wire.

examples.text: Necesito cincuenta tramos de alambre de tres metros.
examples.en: I need fifty ten-foot-long segments of wire.
